properties.name: Claude Code on the dev box kills background cargo runs under a "low memory" rule with 8 GiB free, and blocks foreground sleeps beyond a few seconds — a detached run survives
properties.statement: Measured repeatedly 2026-09-11/12 in the Claude Code harness on the dev box: a `cargo test` launched as a harness background task is killed with "the system is running low on memory" while `free` shows ~8 GiB available; a foreground `sleep` longer than a few seconds is refused. What works: launch the long run DETACHED — `setsid nohup bash -c '… > out.txt 2>&1; echo rc=$? >> out.txt' &` — and watch the output file with the harness's Monitor tool and an `until grep -q '^rc=' out.txt` loop; wrap cargo in `systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=6G` as the box's OOM note already asks. Also: `pkill -f "<pattern>"` where the pattern matches the shell that issued it kills that shell (exit 144). Harness-specific and box-specific, recorded on the dev environment so any agent on this box meets it; moved here from an agent's machine-local memory file (rule:a-rule-the-project-follows-lives-in-the-graph-not-in-an-agents-memory).
